# AMTV Shield

Personal-use fork of megarohas/apple-music-android-tv for NVIDIA Shield TV Pro / Android 11.
The Android WebView hosts Apple's web player and a remote-friendly TV interface.
Playback/session/API access is isolated in res/raw/music_backend.js; this is not a native MusicKit player.

Read README.md, SHIELD.md, ARCHITECTURE.md and SHIELD-TESTS.md for the current fork.
Package: com.megarohas.amtv.shield. Build: tools/build-shield.sh.
Original upstream docs are preserved in README.upstream.md and README.ru.md.
No Apple credentials or signing keys are distributed. IPs and device settings belong in ignored local.mk.
No Play Store publishing, DRM circumvention, Dolby Atmos or lossless implementation.
